confirmed.title: Reset on an untouched board clears the hint message (FR-58 says it changes nothing)
confirmed.evidence: The spec (openspec/specs/play-page/spec.md:670, Reset button) says: 'on an untouched board it SHALL act at once, with no dialog, and change no cell text, no class and no message (FR-58)'. docs/requirements.md:110 FR-58 says the same: 'on an untouched board it acts at once, with no dialog, and changes nothing'. In the code, requestAction (play-page.ts:398-401) runs resetBoard() straight away when hasEntries() is false, and resetBoard always runs `shownHint = null; hintMessage.textContent = ''` (lines 417-418). You can reach this state: press Hint (it fills cell X and shows the sentence), then click X until it is empty. The board has no entries again, and the hint sentence stays on screen, as 'Hint message stays until the next hint or a new puzzle' requires. I ran this in jsdom with seed 42 and the real engine. Before Reset the message was «Два нулі поспіль у стовпці 2, …». After Reset it was "", and showModal was called 0 times. The scenario 'Reset on an untouched board changes nothing and asks nothing' only covers a page with no player action at all, so the suite does not test this path.
confirmed.suggestion: In the reset handler, skip resetBoard when hasEntries() is false (an untouched board has nothing to reset), or make resetBoard leave the messages alone in that case. Add a scenario for this path: hint, then undo the hinted cell by clicks, then Reset, and assert the hint message is unchanged and showModal is not called. If the intended behaviour is to clear the message, change FR-58 and the Reset requirement instead.
verifierNotes: Confirmed by reading play-page.ts.
